summary: All 98 focused tests pass. RB4-01 closes for its three recorded cases. New source cases still permit encoded credential writes. Malformed brace input also causes quadratic synchronous work.
blocking_findings: RB5-01 high: src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:1172-1177 and 488-521 misses JSON arrays outside a parsed root or decoded string. A fenced root array keeps its object elements but loses scalar string elements. A safe review followed by an array has the same gap. Unicode escapes hide the credential from the raw scan. Both providers then write the raw answer and record call success. A safe review inside the mixed text can also retain PASS. Extend prose and fence extraction to every JSON value, including arrays and scalar roots.

RB5-02 high: src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:1173 and 1200-1202 walks only the object that JSON.parse returns. JSON.parse discards earlier duplicate keys and values. An escaped credential in an earlier duplicate value or key therefore receives no scan. The raw scan cannot see that credential. Both providers persist the original bytes and record success. Detect duplicate keys before evidence writes, or scan every syntactic key and value before object construction.

RB5-03 high: src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:1172-1177 and 513-517 converts parse errors into extraction fallback or silence. A malformed unknown field can hold an escaped credential without any decoded scan. The parser returns an unclear FAIL review, but both providers still write raw evidence and record call success. Parse errors must not bypass credential inspection. Preserve safe malformed-answer behavior only after a complete credential check.

RB5-04 medium: src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:488-521 performs quadratic work on unmatched opening braces. Each opening brace starts a scan to the end when no closing brace exists. A 65,536-byte string of opening braces causes about 2.15 billion loop iterations. The synchronous walker yields no event-loop turns during this work. Kimi permits that input size, and MiniMax has no answer-size limit by design. T111 uses valid nested JSON and does not exercise this path. Use one bounded scanning pass and add a malformed 65,536-byte time case.
nonblocking_findings: RB5-05 low: Mutation 9 and mutation 17 pass against the required falsification rows. Neither gap adds a defect to the committed walker. Mutation 9 leaves re-extraction performance unfalsified. Mutation 17 leaves future blanket error handling unfalsified. RB5-04 independently confirms an availability gap. Keep both mutation gaps open for adversarial testing.

source_derived_cases.name: fenced root array with a safe review and an escaped scalar credential
source_derived_cases.construction: const secret = 'sk-' + 'SYNTHETIC'.repeat(4); const escaped = Array.from(secret, c => String.fromCharCode(92) + 'u' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(4, '0')).join(''); const safe = { verdict: 'PASS', reason: 'The subject is visible.', observedCounts: { subject: 1 }, issues: [] }; const raw = '```json\n' + JSON.stringify([safe, secret]).replaceAll(secret, escaped) + '\n```';
source_derived_cases.expected_after_remediation: Both providers refuse before evidence writes. MiniMax may append its sanitized failure entry. Kimi leaves its begin ledger unchanged.

source_derived_cases.name: safe review followed by an escaped root array
source_derived_cases.construction: Use the same secret, escaped, and safe values. const raw = JSON.stringify(safe) + '\n' + JSON.stringify([secret]).replaceAll(secret, escaped);
source_derived_cases.expected_after_remediation: The mixed-text walker checks the array scalar before either provider writes evidence.

source_derived_cases.name: escaped credential in an earlier duplicate value
source_derived_cases.construction: Use the same secret and escaped values. const raw = '{"verdict":"PASS","reason":"The subject is visible.","observedCounts":{"subject":1},"issues":[],"unknown":"' + escaped + '","unknown":"safe"}';
source_derived_cases.expected_after_remediation: Both providers detect the earlier duplicate value and refuse before evidence writes.

source_derived_cases.construction: Use the same secret and escaped values. const raw = '{"verdict":"PASS","reason":"The subject is visible.","observedCounts":{"subject":1},"issues":[],"' + escaped + '":1,"' + escaped + '":2}';
source_derived_cases.expected_after_remediation: Both providers detect the duplicate credential key and refuse before evidence writes.

source_derived_cases.expected_after_remediation: The parse error cannot bypass inspection. Both providers refuse before evidence writes and retain sanitized errors.
